'''Hol Okand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Flying under the callsign [[Gold Six/Legends|Gold Six]], Okand flew with the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] in the early years of the Alliance. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Okand played a role in disabling the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outpost at [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where he flew as [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon Vander's]] wingman, using his [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to bring down the shields.<ref name="Gold 6">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Gold 6}}</ref><ref name="Hol Okand">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Hol Okand}}</ref>

While stationed at [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]], Okand was befriended by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], newly arrived with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] prior to the arrival of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="Hol Okand" /> In the following battle, Okand lost his life after his fighter was shot down by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hol Okand first appeared as an unnamed Rebel Pilot in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> He was later identified and given a brief backstory in the ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], published in [[November]] of [[1998]].<ref name="Gold 6" /> Although ''[[Decipher]]'' established that he was a member of Gold Squadron, a primarily Y-Wing filled squadron, Okand himself is seen sitting in a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] in the film.<ref name="ANH" />
